description: Returns every invoice for one customer that is past its due date and not fully paid, as of a given date, with the outstanding total. Aggregation is done in SQL. Use this for any question about what a customer owes.

asOfDate.description: Evaluate overdue status as of this date.

customer.description: Customer name or numeric ID. Must resolve to a real customer.

name: getOverdueInvoices
title: Overdue invoices for a customer
